description: This file defines CLI commands and helper functions for managing user attributes in the Mattermost server, including command setup, attribute building, and template functions for display.

methods.name: buildFieldAttrs
methods.description: Builds attribute map for user attribute fields based on command flags and existing attributes.

methods.name: hasAttrsChanges
methods.description: Checks if command flags related to attribute changes have been modified.

methods.name: getFieldFromArg
methods.description: Retrieves a property field by ID or name from the list of CPA fields.

methods.name: setupCPATemplateContext
methods.description: Sets up template functions for resolving field names, types, and display values.

methods.name: resolveDisplayValue
methods.description: Converts raw field values into human-readable format.

methods.name: resolveOptionDisplayValue
methods.description: Converts option IDs to option names for select/multiselect fields.
